digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria registry and validation enforcement
propositions: Validation logic is currently implemented in CLI commands while MCP/library/reconciler code paths bypass it, creating inconsistent enforcement.
A new advisory criterion project.engine-layer-enforcement must be registered to detect when plan file impacts touch CLI command or interface modules while implementing validation/guard/check work.
The plan-review criterion should fire when validation is placed CLI-only and suggest moving the invariant enforcement to the engine layer.
Registry routing and criterion definition must be added via .rebar/criteria_routing.json overlay and reflected in generated criteria guide.
rebar explain project.engine-layer-enforcement must successfully retrieve and display the criterion definition.
